description:
Plan: ../recursive-denotations-proposal.html. Stack of PRs on main: PR1 reproducers+signal, PR2 fz-tfn.62 narrow, PR3 fz-kdt.48, PR4 fz-kdt.177 kernel, PR5 fz-kdt.177 semantics.

PR2, after the retention commit. quoted_function.rs ~443 turns an unrecognised head atom back into Expr::Var/Expr::Call and resolve_runtime_function (jobs/body.rs ~2036) re-resolves the dotted string in the CALLER's namespace (also world.rs ~1994 lookup_callable_namespace's qualified arm, body.rs ~1308). The decode boundary consults the classification first; delete quoted_callable_name and the dotted-string lookup arm. Tests: the FutureMacros case from fz-tfn.62's TDD (App binds FutureMacros only as F, requires F.twice/1, the provider macro quotes a call to its own double/1), both submission orders, returning 42 with the helper lowered to the provider's exact FunctionId; and a caller binding the alias to another module cannot redirect the quoted helper. Signal: no production site resolves a callable by rendered name after expansion (grep census).
title: Read the retained callable at decode; delete caller-namespace re-resolution
